ns2:section.sectionText: PHYS 497 is a supplement to PHYS 225 and is intended for students who wish to explore more advanced elements of special relativity and mathematical physics. Concurrent registration in PHYS 225 is required as the supplementary assignments will be synchronized with the presentation of topics in PHYS 225.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to BS:Engineering Physics -UIUC, BS:Physics -UIUC, BSLAS:Physics -UIUC, or BSLAS:Physics:Teaching Op-UIUC.
